restaurantName: Adam Rd Noo Cheng Big Prawn Noodle
address: Adam Food Centre, #01-27, 2 Adam Road, 289876, Singapore
bio: The prawn mee cooked à la minute is a recipe from the owner’s father. Opt for “dry” noodles tossed in prawn paste of your desired level of heat, alongside a bowl of prawn soup. Toppings like pig skin add contrasting textures....
